entries.title: A click on a card's button counts as your go-ahead
entries.body: When you click a button such as Rerun the checks on one of the first mate's cards or a crewmate's, the first mate now takes that click as your go-ahead, the way Merge anyway always counted, instead of asking you to type approval words. A message you send while the first mate is reading a crewmate's report counts too, and words you already gave on a task carry over, so you are never asked to say the same yes twice.
entries.noPicture: No screen changes; the first mate stops asking for typed approval words after a click, and the activity line it writes for the go-ahead already exists.
